description: Returns the verification status of a custom domain and refreshes verification, DNS config, and certificate state. Inputs: slug, domain, and token. status is pending_dns, verifying, issuing_cert, active, or error. dns_records are the records to create. An error includes the reason.

slug.description: Slug the hostname is attached to.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: domain_status
title: Check custom domain status
